adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the feed item content is transformed with `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then passed into `TopicEmbed.import`. That method persists it via `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), ... cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], skip_validations: true)`. With `cook_method == :raw_html`, `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly (skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline), and the embed view renders it using `raw post.cooked`. Therefore, unescaping entities (e.g. `<script>`) can indeed turn previously escaped markup into executable HTML that is stored and later rendered unsanitized.
